title: Selling a Houston House With a Neglected Pool: Compare First
description: Before fixing a neglected Houston pool, clarify safety, inspection limits and repair scope. Compare a documented repair plan with selling the house as-is.

faq.q: Must I restore a neglected pool before asking Cash As-Is for an offer?
faq.a: You can ask for an evaluation with the pool in its current condition. Explain known problems and provide available records; whether Cash As-Is can buy and on what terms depends on the actual property and transaction.

faq.q: Does a standard Texas home inspection automatically include the pool?
faq.a: No. TREC treats pools and spas as optional systems. Confirm the agreed inspection scope and any specialist work separately.

faq.q: Does a pool inspection rule out every underground leak?
faq.a: No. TREC's minimum pool inspection does not require determining pool-shell or subsurface leaks. Ask what testing was actually performed.

faq.q: Should I fill a pool with dirt before selling?
faq.a: Compare a documented removal proposal with repair and as-is options first. Confirm local permits, utility work, drainage and completion records before authorizing removal; do not assume a truckload of fill is a complete solution.
